Find out what this means PROPERTY TYPE Flat BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 2 SIZE Ask agent No floorplan +5 Description Detailed Description The Picture House is not simply a place to lay your head down, but the community you are looking for in East London. A collection of light and modern 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments . The large open plan living space is perfect for entertaining and the kitchen is fitted with integrated appliances including a dishwasher. All fitted with Fibre Hyperopic connections and available furnished or unfurnished. Furry friend you'd like to keep by your side? Not a problem, we are completely pet friendly. Please contact a member of our team for our pet policy. Amenities Living at The Picture House means more than a new home, we take community seriously. Our residents benefit from exclusive access to all onsite amenities including a beautiful landscaped roof terrace, fully fitted gym with state of the art equipment and the Residents' lounge including a flexible work space. The friendly onsite staff are available 24/7 to assist with any queries or issues and throw exclusive resident events throughout the year. Making your neighbour more than someone to water the plants while you're away. Tenancy Subject to contract and satisfactory references, the apartment is to be let on an assured periodic tenancy. The tenant is responsible for the payment of outgoings including council tax, electricity, heating, water & telephone / broadband. A returnable deposit equivalent to 5 weeks rent will be required prior to the commencement of the tenancy. This sum will be returned at the end of the term less any amount for dilapidations or breaches of the terms of the tenancy agreement. The deposit will be held in the TDS deposit scheme Location Located in Ilford, just 2 minutes' walk from Ilford station, The Picture House has great connections to the City and Central London. Serviced by Elizabeth Line, Canary Wharf, Stratford and London Bridge are all accessible in under 20 minutes and Kings Cross in 25 minutes. *All content, imagery and information contained in this listing are included for general marketing purposes only. They should not be relied on to provide an exact representation of the properties available.
